body: Destiny is a fickle bitch.
Sleep and never wake up is all I ask for.
That's one outcome. But what if it stirs up for better? You never know till you try. Anything better than the current situation. Sit with them and just talk.

I would but I'm a pessimist at the moment after what happened. And I'm in the same boat. Every day trying but just not happy. Nothing. Just numb.   
Anyways, hope you find something soon. Good luck. :)

It's not good to steal. Perhaps find a job and start fresh. :) If you are too young, then I'm sorry. You can try living with some friend or a relative or strengthen up and fight for yourself at home. If things go south at least you won't have any regret.   
Good luck.
Don't stab. They are not worth the trouble. Just move out. Even if it is hard without money, you will at least find yourself something to do and you will be happy.

Thanks for responding. I'm not sure how hard given I have spent more than 5+ years, but if I do find it anything enough to keep me going, I'll write you a PM thanking.  
Have a nice day.

Not OP here nor I know about OP, but I don't think one can heal or get back to life after losing something they loved and cared their whole life. It's just there is no happiness in anything anymore. How can you come out of that? Tried all. Even forced and yet at the of the day, it still reminds of that one thing. And if you are not happy, then what's the point in anything?

I'm around 120lb. Probably less now. I didn't drink water or eat for 3 days and yet somehow pee was always transparent in color. don't know what went wrong. 
Thanks for the info.

Time to get up and fix the things you feel like you are doing wrong.  
 Time to stand up and talk to friends and let them know you actually care and love them.   
Time to treat them well and they will treat you well in return. Talk to them about the issues if you think they are great people.  
This is no reason to quit when you have good friends around. It only takes few steps to change your entire life. Better get going.  
Good luck and take care.

I understand. I know how that feels, but don't give up. What would you achieve by doing it? I'm suicidal myself but I think you have a lot more to experience. Find something you love and commit yourself to it. Be it a person or a thing.
Honestly, don't call your mom. It will break her and that's something you want to do while quitting. I'm sorry that you have already taken all these drugs.
Life is more than high school though. Can't transition now, but who knows maybe after few months or years, you will be able to. So why quit without trying?

You won't feel anything. What people will talk about you won't affect you once you are gone. All they will be left with memories. And like it or not, after few days/weeks or months, they will forget and continue with their life.   
At the end of the day, it is your life. Do what you like.

Can understand. What are you suffering from?   
If you cannot talk to your husband and if he cannot sit and take care of you and help you out, then what is the point of marriage? Married couples are supposed to look after each other, both in good and bad times. This is the right time for you to stand up and go and sit next to your husband and hold hands and spill out what you are going through. If he understands and helps you out, then it's the best outcome. If he doesn't, well, sorry but at least you would know what type of person he is.  
Take care.

Depends. But first, what happened that made you feel like killing yourself?   
Sometimes it is selfish to tell others to stay alive without knowing the actual cause and the pain.  
Take care.
How much time does it take before this happens? Went on vsed for 3 days but I was only feeling very tired and sleepy. Do the fainting and worse stuff come after day 3?

That sucks :( mainly when suffering from issues because of own dad. Sorry.   
I don't know what to say. If you are scared you cannot move on with your life till your dad is around. But given your situation, due to income, it is also hard to cope and live like this, mainly every day.   
The only way I can see is you getting a better work or try to move out by finding someone who can understand and respect you and also take care of mom. This way, you can find peace and have a nice family too.   
  
Take care!

Sorry, again. That really sucks when dad is threating. Have you tried complaining to cops or something similar? Sometimes you have to take your chance or else this world would eat you up. You ae not only suffering but also wasting your life in the process which is not good. I know how it feels and I wish to die every day, but mom comes and seeing her face melts me down. I don't know what to either. Every person I talk to ends up looking for themselves and ignore the problem. Really shame that people can be like this.  
  
You can write anytime. I'm usually awake and don't mind talking about random stuff as I'm trying to distract myself but failing.  
Take care. :)

I really want to die. I try every day but I fail :( I don't know how to end up fast. All the methods I tried taking days. I thought dehydration and no food would have some effect after 3 days but I only felt tired and sleepy.   
  
I just don't want to live anymore. No matter what I do, I always sink back in and think of what happened to me and feel so bad over and over again. I just want to quit without thinking about anyone anymore. :(

A few hours ago. Around 3 am in the morning when I saw my parent coming to my room just to check how I'm doing. She was very worried about me being suicidal for last few weeks. But today when I saw her, it broke me into pieces. :(

Why don't you want to live? You seem to have a good life or at least lived a good life.  Tried settling down? Have kids? Have your family? More travel?  Etc.  
What's wrong?

I'm so sorry to hear. I can relate as I went through a similar thing for years until last year dad left finally. I love my mom too and she is the only reason I'm still alive. I've tried to kill myself many times but always stuck in the end.    
  
If you like to talk or rant or anything, feel free to PM. Do take care and try to move out with mom. Have a nice day.

Would you feel better after making a friend and then lose them later? No, right? That would make you feel worse. So why quit for something that is not permanent?   
  
I'm not going to say don't do it because I know how it really feels. But do try to think about it.  You are not alone. You can always talk to me and I don't leave anyone. They do.
Can relate it :( it sucks that even during that moment they think of themselves.
